content: Round trip training is another important source of inspiration, as it can be viewed as a way to use BT to perform semi-unsupervised BIBREF32 or unsupervised BIBREF33 training of NMT. The most convincing attempt to date along these lines has been proposed by BIBREF26 , who propose to use GANs to mitigate the difference between artificial and natural data.
